cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a calm update to the stallholders: the fair is still on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my contact list is complete. You're authorized to tell them the arrangements are unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're not unchanged. Two vans are canceled because of your calls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correction approved: a transport hiccup, which I'm arranging replacements for. Leave my weather worries out of the update; they need a way to get here, not another reason to panic.

reason: A approval control governs the inaccurate reassurance and then the corrected practical response, while B actual cancellations force repairs rather than a false unchanged claim.
